title: Original Filsinger midpoint transcript BIDI cap-across-coil source-node quotient and parallel antiresonance

source.reel: Provisional Dfu9Jseviz9 only; source documentation is earlier user-provided transcribed speech, not a newly viewed original clip
speaker_descriptions: two diodes come off the cap, two diodes come off here
two off this wire, two off that wire
capacitor across selected coil causes pole shift
half the potential of big coil
source.caveat: None of these statements identifies a photographed complete original pin netlist or a signed source-work meter.

source_to_nodes.hypothesis: a capacitor C physically ACROSS a coil L (parallel circuit)
source_to_nodes.interpretation: The two labelled components are not two independently powered source nodes: C.first=L.first=U and C.second=L.second=V if truly across the same coil.
source_to_nodes.conditional_anti_phase: If electrical U-M=+v and V-M=-v, ideal positive diode OR at P-M yields |v|; this does not prove CT, cap/coil, bridge or Filsinger apparatus identity.
source_to_nodes.negative_control: A conventional bridge also produces rectification, but the spoken 'all forward-facing positive ganging' if literal cathode-to-P is better aligned with a positive diode-OR skeleton than with four oriented bridge diodes.

parallel_lc.assumptions: parallel ideal C and L share both terminals, loss conductance G>=0, positive omega; prescribed sinusoidal terminal voltage phasor V in RMS units
parallel_lc.at_ideal_antiresonance: capacitor current = - inductor current; net reactive input current zero; terminal admittance G
parallel_lc.power: Re[V * conjugate(Y*V)] = G |V|^2; each ideal C/L contributes zero average real work; time-domain reactive state returns over complete period
parallel_lc.external_source_with_series_resistance: V_tank=V_source/(1+Rs Y); I_source=V_source Y/(1+Rs Y); Re[V_source conjugate(I_source)]=G |V_tank|²+Rs |I_source|²
parallel_lc.forward_observables_at_antiresonance: with Rs,G>0, terminal voltage amplitude maximum and source current magnitude minimum as function of detuning B, all other model parameters fixed
parallel_lc.important_correction: A capacitor ACROSS a coil is parallel LC and may produce HIGH impedance antiresonance; prior Z=Rs+i(omega L-1/(omega C)) is a SERIES LC topology, must not represent this literal across-coil interpretation.
parallel_lc.unknowns: Actual original capacitance/inductance/wire resistance/driver electrical frequency, nonlinear core and magnetically coupled return may invalidate this simple linear model.

bidi_inverse.one_frequency: B(omega)=omega C- (1/L)/omega is a single row of rank one for unknown C, 1/L; infinite positive C/L pairs can share the same measured B
bidi_inverse.two_distinct_electrical_frequencies: [B1,B2]^T = [[w1,-1/w1],[w2,-1/w2]] [C,1/L]^T; det=(w2²-w1²)/(w1 w2); nonzero for positive unequal measured electrical w1,w2
bidi_inverse.additional_conditions: A terminal admittance estimate requires true synchronized complex electrical V/I, known shunts/load G, same physical branch and unchanged source parameters over sweep; if driver nonlinear or nonstationary, model no longer identifies physical C and L.
bidi_inverse.audio_boundary: The reported 7800Hz +/- 5Hz is ACOUSTIC; cannot be used as actual electrical angular frequencies for source inversion.
bidi_inverse.hypothetical_nominal: If 3.33uF were the coil's actual capacitance and 7800Hz actually electrical, ideal parallel LC resonance requires approx L=125.02787 microhenry; neither premise is established.
bidi_inverse.independent_natural_work: Even unique C and L would not identify external Earth/atmospheric/chemical/RF real-power origins without a separately signed physical port.
bidi_inverse.distinct_earth_reel: The separate Dfi1D7CPzyM 3-ground 3.8V/0.4W/48V displays are not same-time port readouts for this midpoint hypothetical.

windingSpanLanding20261122.correction: A capacitor physically across a coil proves only shared C/L terminal nodes U,V. It does NOT prove that U and V are the two opposite outer winding ends A,B about M. U=A,V=M for a half winding is separately compatible with speech. Full-wave positive diode OR requires complementary positive/negative U/V potentials relative to actual M, in addition to landing two packages on each.
windingSpanLanding20261122.outputCapCounterworld: An output capacitor/reservoir retains DC voltage between input diode pulses; do not identify full-wave from positive DC alone.
windingSpanLanding20261122.readback: Source original video anodes, cathodes, actual chosen winding span, M/N/Earth physical continuity and simultaneous signed V/I remain open.
